entities.summary: Mimoza Ahmeti is an Albanian poet, writer and the winner of the first Festival of Poetry in Sanremo in 1988, organized by RAI. She has been described by Robert Elsie as an "enfant terrible." Mimoza is a postdoctoral lecturer in psychotherapy. She graduated with a PhD degree from SFU Vienna with honors and completed her postdoctoral studies at SFU Paris. Mimoza Ahmeti was a poets & playwrights from Krujë (b. 1963-12-25, Krujë).
